The best of bare knuckle fighting featuring Bobby Taylor vs Gabe Freyre. Watch Jarred Warren fight Jay Jackson, and Reggie Barnett Jr defends the interim bantamweight belt against Geane Herrera.
A collection of battles featuring Sarah Click vs Jessica Borga, Travis Thompson vs David Diaz, followed by a slugfest between Joshua Ridge and Chancey Wilson.
Nicholas Blume and Alex Davis open hostilities in a blistering exchange of heavy leather-free shots, while Roberto Armas and AJ Iriarte go to war in a back-and-forth battle that refuses to slow down.
An exciting bare knuckle fight between Brandon Meyer and Shane Moffitt opens up the show followed by Sarah Shell vs Audra Cummings and Drako Rodriguez challenges Will Shutt.
Trinidad-Snake fights Riley, followed by Sean Wilson vs Kevin Croom in an epic battle, and wraps up with two combat sports legends Joey Beltran vs Houston Alexander in Nebraska.
Bryan Duran faces off against first-time bare-knuckle brawler Kobe Bowen, then Blake Davis takes on Will Dunkle and Cuban Christine Vincens fights MMA brawler Jocelyn Lybarger-Jones.
Matt Russo takes on Brett Lowry followed by Jeremy Smith vs Leo Valdivia, and Guillermo Perez dukes it out with Rob Fuller.

Exciting featherweights Louie Lopez and Howard Davis get it with a flash bang! Then watch a middleweight title fight between Francisco Ricci and David Mandell followed by a lightweight title fight between Luis Palomino and Tom Shoaff.
